sections.text_helper: Section 24.3.3 "GPIO controlled by the RTC" in chapter 24 (Real-time clock (RTC)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 649.
sections.section_content:
RTC_OUT1 and RTC_TS are mapped on the same pin.
This pin output mechanism follows the priority order shown in Table100.
[Table 100. Pin configuration(1)]
In addition, it is possible to output RTC_OUT2 thanks to OUT2EN bit. The different functions
are mapped on RTC_OUT1 or on RTC_OUT2 depending on OSEL, COE and OUT2EN
configuration, as show in table Table101.
[Table 101. RTC_OUT mapping]
